description: Phi-3 is Microsoft's family of small language models optimized for resource-constrained environments. Available in Mini (3.8B), Small (7B), and Medium (14B) sizes, these models achieve performance exceeding many larger models through high-quality training data.

trainingData.description: Trained using the 'Textbooks Are All You Need 2.0' approach with high-quality synthetic data and carefully filtered web data. Focus on reasoning and educational content.

trainingProcedure: High-quality data curation following textbook methodology. Small models trained to match larger model performance through data quality.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Phi-3 Mini (3.8B) exceeds performance of many 7B-13B models. Strong on reasoning and instruction following.

knownLimitations: Smaller models have reduced capability on complex tasks
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Safety tuning applied to instruct variants.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights enable local and edge deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

requirements.deployment: Local deployment, edge/mobile deployment, or cloud via Azure AI

hardware.Mini_3.8B: Can run on mobile devices, ~8GB RAM

references.technicalReport: Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone
